name: Foot-operation qualifier
summary: This qualifier identifies actuation by a foot-operated mechanism.
description: This qualifier identifies actuation by a foot-operated mechanism. A foot-operated mechanism allows an operator action to be applied through a pedal or similar member. The electrical function remains in the associated switch or control contacts.
A foot operation can initiate a pulse or maintain a state, depending on the device. Show the actual return and latch behaviour so the circuit is readable without guessing from the actuator type.
readingNotes: Link the actuation indication to its contact set and defined release behaviour.
A foot actuator may be momentary or maintained; its return behaviour needs a separate indication.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Link the actuation indication to its contact set and defined release behaviour.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
